# Grafynt

> Grafynt is an AI agency that helps companies discover, build, deploy, and operate intelligent systems. We ship AI automations, agentic workflows, custom AI assistants, and AI-built websites for clients worldwide.

Grafynt is based in Indonesia and serves global clients. Founded by Jonathan (AI Architect) and Yefta (Creative Ops). Most projects ship in under 10 days. Email: grafynt@gmail.com.

## Services

- **AI Automations & Agentic Systems**: Autonomous agents for multi-step workflows, custom AI assistants on WhatsApp/Slack/email, and workflow automation with AI decision-making. Starting at $3,599 USD.
- **AI-Built Websites**: Full design and build in under 10 days, AI-powered content and copywriting, SEO and GEO-optimized, performance-first code. Starting at $1,799.

## Pricing

- **AI-Built Websites: $1,799.** Landing or 3-page website, AI-assisted design and copy, deployed in under 7 days, 2 rounds of revisions.
- **AI Automation Systems: $3,599.** Discovery and system design, one production AI workflow, WhatsApp/Slack/email bot, integration with your stack, eval and monitoring, team training.
- **AI Operations Agent: $5,399.** Multi-agent architecture, custom dashboards and tools, API and system integrations, ongoing optimization, direct founder access.

## Process

1. **Discover.** Learn the business. No assumptions.
2. **Architect.** Design, map, prototype. Validate before building.
3. **Build.** AI-augmented delivery. Fast, without compromise.
4. **Train.** Launch, monitor, train the team. The client owns the system.

## Team

- **Jonathan**: Founder & AI Architect. Strategy, AI architecture, product vision.
- **Yefta**: Co-Founder & Creative Ops. Creative direction, client operations, content strategy.

## Frequently asked questions

**How fast does Grafynt deliver?** Most websites ship in under 10 days. AI automations and agentic systems scope to 2–4 weeks depending on integrations.

**Does Grafynt work with non-technical founders?** Yes. Most clients are non-technical. Grafynt handles the technical decisions, explains trade-offs in plain language, and trains the team to run the system after launch.

**What happens after launch?** Every project includes monitoring setup, documentation, and a team training session. Optional retainers cover ongoing optimization.

**Can services be combined?** Yes. The most common combination is a website plus an AI assistant for the site, priced as a custom package after discovery.

**Does Grafynt take equity or revenue share?** For the right strategic fit, yes. Evaluated case by case.
